title: NSGo game 2D particle emitter (version 1)
description: EmitterDoc describes the versioned YAML schema of a 2D particle emitter definition (version: 1) for JSON Schema generation.

version.description: Version is the schema version; it must be FormatVersion (1).

x.description: X is the emitter's default horizontal position in points.

y.description: Y is the emitter's default vertical position in points.

rotation.description: Rotation is the emitter's rotation in radians, clockwise on screen.

space.description: Space controls whether particles simulate in world coordinates ("world") or emitter-local coordinates ("local").

shape.description: Shape controls where new particles spawn relative to the emitter's origin.

rate.description: Rate is how many particles emit per second during Update; 0 disables continuous emission.

bursts.description: Bursts schedules automatic bursts of particles at specific elapsed times during Update.

maxParticles.description: MaxParticles caps how many particles may be live at once (defaults to 256 when 0 or omitted).

lifetimeMin.description: LifetimeMin is the minimum particle lifetime as a Go duration string such as "300ms".

lifetimeMax.description: LifetimeMax is the maximum particle lifetime as a Go duration string such as "700ms".

speedMin.description: SpeedMin is the minimum initial particle speed in points per second.

speedMax.description: SpeedMax is the maximum initial particle speed in points per second.

angleMin.description: AngleMin is the minimum initial direction of travel in radians, clockwise from +X.

angleMax.description: AngleMax is the maximum initial direction of travel in radians, clockwise from +X.

gravityX.description: GravityX is constant horizontal acceleration in points per second squared.

gravityY.description: GravityY is constant vertical acceleration in points per second squared.

initialRotationMin.description: InitialRotationMin is the minimum starting particle rotation in radians.

initialRotationMax.description: InitialRotationMax is the maximum starting particle rotation in radians.

rotationSpeedMin.description: RotationSpeedMin is the minimum angular velocity in radians per second.

rotationSpeedMax.description: RotationSpeedMax is the maximum angular velocity in radians per second.

sizeCurve.description: SizeCurve scales each particle over its normalized lifetime in [0, 1].

alphaCurve.description: AlphaCurve fades each particle's opacity over its normalized lifetime in [0, 1].

rotationCurve.description: RotationCurve adds rotation in radians over a particle's normalized lifetime in [0, 1].

colorCurve.description: ColorCurve tints each particle over its normalized lifetime in [0, 1].

seed.description: Seed seeds the emitter's deterministic PCG PRNG.

z.description: Z sets the sprite Z draw order of emitted particles.

frameNames.description: FrameNames lists the atlas frame names particles pick from at spawn time.

collision.description: Collision configures optional particle collision response.

trail.description: Trail configures optional per-particle 2D ribbon trails.

subEmitters.description: SubEmitters configures child bursts triggered on particle birth, death or collision.

BurstDoc.description: BurstDoc describes one scheduled particle burst in YAML.

time.description: Time is the elapsed emitter time when the first burst fires, as a Go duration string such as "250ms".

count.description: Count is the number of particles emitted on each firing.

cycles.description: Cycles is how many times the burst fires (0 or 1 means once; negative repeats indefinitely every interval).

interval.description: Interval is the delay between repeated firings as a Go duration string such as "1s".

CollisionDoc.description: CollisionDoc describes particle collision settings in YAML.

enabled.description: Enabled turns particle collision checking on when a runtime Collider is attached.

mode.description: Mode selects the impact response: "none", "stop", "bounce" or "kill".

bounce.description: Bounce is the restitution factor applied to normal velocity in "bounce" mode.

friction.description: Friction damps tangential velocity on impact in "bounce" mode, clamped to [0, 1].

radius.description: Radius is the particle collision radius in points.

ColorStopDoc.description: ColorStopDoc is one control point on a color curve at normalized age t in [0, 1].

t.description: T is the normalized particle age in [0, 1].

color.description: Color is a quoted hex color string "#rrggbb" or "#rrggbbaa".

EmitterFieldsDoc.description: EmitterFieldsDoc describes the fields of a 2D particle emitter configuration (used at the top level and inside sub-emitters without version).

y.description: Y is the emitter's default vertical position in points.

speedMin.description: SpeedMin is the minimum initial particle speed in points per second.

speedMax.description: SpeedMax is the maximum initial particle speed in points per second.

collision.description: Collision configures optional particle collision response.

trail.description: Trail configures optional per-particle 2D ribbon trails.

subEmitters.description: SubEmitters configures child bursts triggered on particle birth, death or collision.

FloatStopDoc.description: FloatStopDoc is one control point on a float curve at normalized age t in [0, 1].

t.description: T is the normalized particle age in [0, 1].

value.description: Value is the curve value at T.

ShapeDoc.description: ShapeDoc describes a 2D emission shape in YAML.

radius.description: Radius is the radius in points for "circle" and "ring" shapes.

width.description: Width is the width in points for a "rect" shape.

height.description: Height is the height in points for a "rect" shape.

SubEmitterDoc.description: SubEmitterDoc describes one child burst rule in YAML.

trigger.description: Trigger selects which parent particle event fires the burst: "birth", "death" or "collision".

burstCount.description: BurstCount is how many child particles to emit on each trigger event.

inheritVelocity.description: InheritVelocity multiplies parent velocity added to each spawned child particle.

config.description: Config configures the child emitter (without a version key).

TrailDoc.description: TrailDoc describes per-particle ribbon trail settings in YAML.

maxPoints.description: MaxPoints caps the recorded polyline vertices per trail (defaults to 64 when 0).

lifetime.description: Lifetime is how long each trail vertex lives in seconds (defaults to 0.5 when 0).

minDistance.description: MinDistance is the minimum spacing in points between consecutive trail vertices.

width.description: Width is the base ribbon width in points (defaults to 4 when 0).

widthCurve.description: WidthCurve scales Width from head (t=0) to tail (t=1).

colorGradient.description: ColorGradient evaluates color from head (t=0) to tail (t=1).

color.description: Color is the fallback solid hex color "#rrggbb" or "#rrggbbaa" when colorGradient is empty.

textureURI.description: TextureURI is an optional image URI mapped across trail segments.
